title: The equation that broke the internet
subtitle: is the answer 1 or 16? both, actually.
scriptText: Eight divided by two times two plus two. What's the answer? You don't know. Half of TikTok says one. Half says sixteen. Half of you are wrong. Or are you? Let's break it down. Step one: parentheses. Two plus two is four. Now: eight divided by two times four. Step two: PEMDAS, left to right. Eight divided by two is four. Four times four is sixteen. Answer: sixteen. BUT. If you read two times the parens as one chunk — like two GROUPS of four — it becomes eight divided by eight. Which equals one. Casio calculators say one. TI calculators say sixteen. Math teachers fight about this. PEMDAS is a lie. You're welcome.

beats.text: Casio: 1. TI: 16. PEMDAS is a lie.
